args.query: ledger write failed no space left on device disk full

events.statement: Only one deployment occurred in the window: payment-service v6.0.0 (dep-6203) at 2026-06-01T14:46:00Z, summary 'New UPI mandate flow', which was rolled back at 15:12:00Z.
No configuration or feature-flag changes were recorded for any service in the incident window.

payment-service error_rate was flat at ~0.2% until 14:48, then jumped to ~60.85% (max 66.98) in the 15:00 bucket and remained ~60-63% through 16:48 — i.e., it did NOT recover after the 15:12 rollback.

All 88 payment-service ERROR logs from 15:00:26 to 15:29:30 are a single pattern: 'ledger write failed: ERROR: could not extend file: No space left on device'. No mandate-specific or application-logic errors appear.
payment-service continued emitting the same 'No space left on device' ledger-write errors at full rate after the rollback: 320 further errors from 15:12:08 to 16:57:54.

ledger-db logged PANIC/ERROR 'could not write to file "pg_wal/xlogtemp...": No space left on device' and 'could not extend file "base/16402/2619": No space left on device' beginning 15:01:01, 292 total ERROR entries through 16:57.
ledger-db disk_used_pct climbed steadily from 89.18% (13:00) to 98.52% by 14:30 and saturated at 100.0% from the 15:00 bucket onward, remaining 100% through 16:45.

ledger-db WARN logs show an inactive replication slot retaining tens of GB of WAL starting at 13:02:25 (e.g. 'retaining 33247 MB of WAL'), well before the 14:46 deploy, plus disk-usage warnings 90% (13:10), 95% (14:15), 98% (14:48).

order-service — a separate service with no deployment in the window — emitted 236 identical errors 'INSERT INTO orders failed: No space left on device' starting 15:00:42, contemporaneous with payment-service's failures.
ledger-db is a SHARED datastore read/written by order-service, portfolio-service, payment-service and settlement-service.
payment-service internal health signals were flat/healthy: cpu_pct ~30%, db_pool_in_use ~8, bank_api_error_rate ~0.2%, request_rate ~100 req/s, and restarts stayed 0 throughout.
ledger-db replication_lag_ms climbed monotonically from ~2.3s (13:00) to ~5.2s (16:45), consistent with WAL accumulation rather than query load; slow_queries_per_min stayed ~1/min.
Historical incident HIST-114 (2025-04-18, ledger-db) had the identical root cause: 'Inactive replication slot retained WAL until disk filled', category resource_exhaustion.

Interpretation: the payment-service v6.0.0 deploy's onset (14:46) predates the failure onset (15:00-15:01) by ~15 min, while ledger-db was already at 95%+ disk before the deploy and reached 100% at the same moment failures began — the temporal coincidence is with disk exhaustion, not the release.
